description: Uses the Taifoon orderbook (spot ETH-USDG on Robinhood Chain): account, deposit route, orders, withdrawals, settlement records. For tenant vaults use taifoon_vault. Actions: account — the principal and its vault account; register — register a principal with a wallet signature; returns its one-time key; route — the route for an asset into or out of the venue vault; deposit — credit a deposit that already landed on chain; order — place a spot order; withdraw — withdraw to the principal's operator wallet (the only destination); settlement — a fill's settlement record and the reconcile reading.

account.description: the operator wallet the transfer came from (actions: deposit)

action.description: what to do (default account): account | register | route | deposit | order | withdraw | settlement

api_key.description: api key (actions: account, deposit, order, withdraw)

asset.description: USDG | ETH | WETH | tICP | TRN (actions: route, deposit, withdraw)

from.description: origin chain id (4663 Robinhood Chain, 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum One, 1 Ethereum, 5042 Arc) (actions: route)

operator.description: the wallet (0x…) that signs; deposits come from it, withdrawals go to it (actions: register)

signature.description: EIP-191 signature over the message; omit to get the exact message to sign (actions: register)

signed_at.description: unix seconds in the message (10-minute window) (actions: register)

units.description: whole units as a decimal string, e.g. "1.25" (actions: deposit, withdraw)

name: taifoon_orderbook
title: Orderbook venue
